$comment: Recipe for one project. Copy this file to tool/forge/recipe.json,
fill every field (search '<' to find TODOs), then run:
dart run tool/forge/mint.dart
The forge validates every field against the portfolio registry
and refuses to run if any value collides with a shipped sibling.
See .cursor/rules/portfolio_registry.md for the collision policy.

identity.description: <60-160 chars, describes the WHITE game only>

credentials.attributionDevKey: <AppsFlyer dev key — MUST be new per project>
credentials.messagingProjectId: <Firebase project number — MUST be new per project>

userAgent.$comment: Rotate the Chrome version per project. Range: 149.0.7500.10 .. 149.0.7900.250 (or a fresh major once Chrome moves on).

$comment: family: one of position_xor | fnv_lcg | rc4_ksa (see tool/forge/codecs/).
The operator picks a family that no shipped sibling used. The forge
warns when the previous project used the same family; rotate through
all three before repeating.
salt: 12-24 random bytes (dart run tool/forge/mint.dart --gen-salt)
streamLen: int in [16..48], outside every sibling's value

timings.$comment: See lib/relay/config/relay_config.dart for the accepted ranges. Every value must be outside the corresponding sibling's value by at least 10%.

storage.$comment: 3-5 char ASCII, ending with '_'. See lib/relay/wire/beacon_keystore.dart.

notifications.$comment: Rotate per project. channelId MUST match AndroidManifest.xml default_notification_channel_id.

$comment: enhancers: which JS behaviours ship. Known slots are safeArea,
keyboard, autoplay, viewportTint, keyboardBridge. Drop one canonical
behaviour and add a project-specific one so the arity differs per
project — see .cursor/rules/relay_forge.md §5.
keyboardBridge is special: it is a call template with %INSET% and
%VIEW% placeholders, evaluated by portal_stage rather than installed
on page load. Ship it whenever the keyboard slot ships.
enhancerBodies: slot -> file under tool/forge/jsvariants/. The forge
drops comment-only lines, encodes the body, and verifies the
round-trip. A slot left out of `enhancers` ships as an empty array.

targets.$comment: Which files the forge is allowed to rewrite. Set to false to skip.
